title: SB6673 (2019-2020 Regular): Removing restrictions on the right to bear arms and ensuring personal protection for Washington citizens.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2019-20/Htm/Bills/Senate%20Bills/6673.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version; the bill header says 2020 Regular Session (a 2019-20 biennium bill). Large bill, quotes selected from NEW SECTIONs and the Sec. 12 result; most of Secs. 2-25 strike text from RCW 9.41 and the protective-order chapters (7.90, 7.92, 10.14, 10.99, 26.09, 26.50) and the Sec. 3-10 strikes remove the 2019 c 3 (I-1639) rules on semiautomatic assault rifles, training, and the 10-day period. Sec. 2 deletes the definitions of secure gun storage and semiautomatic assault rifle and adds 'firearm accessories'. Sec. 26(10) repeals a sales tax exemption tied to the background-check rule. Sec. 1 is an uncodified statement of intent and is not quoted. Sec. 14 (bar-area carry exception, added words) quoted by the set-up session at stop 1, 2026-11-13.
